name: Compute
description:
Conversation workflow step that evaluates Blue Expression Objects (BEX) and returns a result.
Compute reads the current processing context and computes data. It does not mutate the document directly. If the result contains a changeset, that changeset is still only data; a separate Conversation/Update Document step must apply it.

expr.description: Optional BEX expression. If present and no `do` body is used, the step result is the evaluated expression.

do.description: Ordered list of BEX statements. Items are intentionally not strongly typed in this repository version.

definition.description: Optional reference to reusable compute logic. In a Conversation workflow, this is commonly a contract key in the current scope pointing to a Conversation/Compute Definition.

entry.description: Entry function name to execute when `definition` or local `functions` are used.

constants.description: Named constants available to BEX through `$const`. Keys are constant names; values are arbitrary Blue values.

functions.description: Named reusable BEX functions. Keys are function names; values are function definitions. Function objects are intentionally not strongly typed in this repository version.

emitEvents.description: If true, and the computed result contains an `events` list, the Conversation workflow processor emits those events.

returnResult.description: If true, the computed result is stored under the workflow step name and can be referenced by later steps.

gasLimit.description: Optional maximum gas allowed for this Compute step. If omitted, the host processor chooses the applicable default.
